newsitem.title: USA: American Healthchoice delays Q1 report.
newsitem.headline: American Healthchoice delays Q1 report.

text.p: American HealthChoice Inc said Thursday it will be delayed in filing its first quarter report on Form 10-QSB for the fiscal year 1997.
The company said it expects to be in full compliance with all filing requirements by March 7.
The company said its delay is primarily due to being backlogged as a result of the late filing earlier this month of the company's Form 10-KSB.
American HealthChoice is a provider of healthcare services and operates primary care clinics located in Texas, Louisiana, and Georgia.
